description: Run a multi-item single-payment pipeline for up to 25 total items: crypto addresses, domains/handles, prompts, URLs, text snippets and git diffs. Returns combined deterministic findings after one $0.005 (5000 atomic) Base USDC x402 payment.

address.description: Single crypto address shorthand (EVM 0x..., Bitcoin 1.../3.../bc1..., TRON T...) to screen against OFAC SDN.

addresses.description: Crypto addresses (EVM 0x..., Bitcoin 1.../3.../bc1..., TRON T...) to screen against OFAC SDN.

brand.description: Target brand for deterministic homoglyph, Punycode, and typosquatting comparison.

candidate.description: Single candidate domain or social handle shorthand to auto-classify and inspect.

candidates.description: Mixed candidate domains or social handles to auto-classify and inspect.

chain.description: Optional chain hint for address screening (e.g. base, ethereum, btc, tron).

diff.description: Single unified git diff or PR patch shorthand (up to 16384 chars) to audit for leaked secrets, destructive shell/SQL, CI injection, malicious lifecycle hooks, SSRF/private IPs, auth/TLS bypass, Trojan Source Unicode, and corrupt hunk counts.

diffs.description: Unified git diffs or PR patches (up to 16384 chars each) to pre-screen before git apply / PR merge.

domain.description: Single candidate domain shorthand (ASCII, Unicode IDN, or Punycode xn--...) to inspect.

domains.description: Candidate domains (ASCII, Unicode IDN, or Punycode xn--...) to inspect.

handle.description: Single candidate social handle shorthand (@handle or bare handle) to inspect.

handles.description: Candidate social handles (@handle or bare handle) to inspect.

officialDomains.description: Optional list of verified official domains for the target brand.

officialHandles.description: Optional list of verified official social handles for the target brand.

patch.description: Alias for `diff`: single unified git diff or patch snippet (up to 16384 chars) to audit.

patches.description: Alias for `diffs`: array of unified git diffs or patch snippets (up to 16384 chars each) to audit.

prompt.description: Single untrusted prompt, MCP tool description, or fetched text (up to 4096 chars) to scan.

prompts.description: Untrusted prompts, MCP tool descriptions, or fetched texts (up to 4096 chars each) to scan for prompt injection, tool poisoning, Unicode tag smuggling, and secret exfiltration.

secret.description: Single text/log/diff/webhook payload shorthand (up to 8192 chars) to scan & redact for leaked API keys, private keys, JWTs, and Bearer tokens.

secrets.description: Text snippets, PR bodies, logs, or webhook payloads (up to 8192 chars each) to scan & redact for leaked API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS, GitHub, Stripe, Slack, Google), PEM/hex private keys, JWTs, and Bearer tokens.

target.description: Single candidate domain, URL, or @handle to screen for brand impersonation, IDN punycode, Unicode confusables, and typosquats.

targets.description: Candidate domains, URLs, or @handles (up to 25) to screen for brand impersonation and homographs.

text.description: Alias for `secret`: single text/log/PR snippet (up to 8192 chars) to scan & redact for leaked secrets.

texts.description: Alias for `secrets`: array of text snippets (up to 8192 chars each) to scan & redact for leaked secrets.

url.description: Single URL shorthand (up to 2048 chars) to inspect for SSRF, private/metadata IPs, dangerous schemes, credentials, IDN homoglyphs, and open redirects.

urls.description: URLs (up to 2048 chars each) to pre-screen before fetch for SSRF (loopback, RFC1918, CGNAT, IPv6 mapped/local, cloud metadata, hex/octal/decimal IP encodings), non-HTTP(S) schemes, credentials, punycode homoglyphs, and open redirects.

name: screen_batch
